title: Vacation Ceiling Schedule and Coverage Review Status (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**Schedule rule.** For a vacation supply under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the vacation ceiling depends on the drug's coverage review under the member's Utilization Management Program:

1. when the drug's latest approval has expired and a coverage review case for the drug is still awaiting decision, the vacation ceiling is the network's maximum vacation days supply multiplied by 0.67, rounded down to whole days;
2. when the latest approval is still in force and expires sooner than the network's maximum vacation days supply in days from today, the vacation ceiling is the days from today to that expiration date;
3. otherwise it is the network's maximum vacation days supply.

The drug's latest approval is its most recently effective approval on the Utilization Management Program records. It has expired when its expiration date is before today, and is in force when its expiration date is today or later. A case is still awaiting decision when it has been opened and has not been approved, denied, withdrawn or automatically approved.

## Ceiling by network

| Network | Maximum vacation days supply | Ceiling under line 1 (multiplied by 0.67, or 67 percent, rounded down) |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Performance Network | 30 | 20 |
| Northbridge Essential Network | 30 | 20 |
| Northbridge National Network | 30 | 20 |
| Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 60 | 40 |
| Northbridge Retail90 Network | 90 | 60 |
| Northbridge Open Choice Network | 90 | 60 |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical, maximum of 30 days)

| Latest approval | Case awaiting decision | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| Expired yesterday | Yes | 20 |
| Expired yesterday | No | 30 |
| Expires in 29 days | Either | 29 |
| Expires in 30 days | Either | 30 (not sooner than 30 days) |
| Expires today | Either | 0 |
| No approval on record | Either | 30 |
